Definition: probably from the base of G1150; a heifer (as tame):--heifer.
BiblicalUsage: The red heifer appears once by this word, in the law of cleansing: its ashes, mixed with water, cleanse the one defiled by touching the dead. A heifer that had never borne a yoke, burned whole, became the means of purification.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the red heifer points forward to a cleansing that no water could give on its own, and finds its answer in Christ.
